guarded.EN: Take one more step and find out.
guarded.TL: Humakbang ka pa nang isa at nang malaman mo.

guarded.EN: Keep your hands off your weapon and step back.
guarded.TL: Alisin ang kamay sa armas at umatras ka.

guarded.EN: Back up before I put you down.
I am not afraid to defend myself. Back off.
guarded.TL: Hindi ako natatakot ipagtanggol ang sarili ko. Lumayo ka.

guarded.EN: Last chance to walk away alive.
guarded.TL: Huling pagkakataon para lumakad palayo nang buhay.

guarded.EN: You don't want this fight. Step back.
guarded.TL: Ayaw mo sa laban na ito. Umatras ka.

guarded.EN: Hands where I can see them. Back off.
guarded.TL: Kamay kung saan ko nakikita. Umatras ka.

neutral.EN: Step back or we have a problem.
You need to back off right now.
Keep your distance. Don't make this turn ugly.
neutral.TL: Panatilihin ang distansya. Huwag mong gawing madugo ito.

neutral.EN: I'm giving you fair warning: stand down.
neutral.TL: Binibigyan kita ng patas na babala: ibaba ang armas.

neutral.EN: Back away. Neither of us needs this fight.
neutral.TL: Umatras ka. Walang nangangailangan ng laban na 'to.

neutral.EN: Step down. Let's not do something stupid.
neutral.TL: Huminahon ka. Huwag tayong gumawa ng katangahan.

neutral.EN: I won't hesitate if you keep advancing.
neutral.TL: Hindi ako magdadalawang-isip kapag lumapit ka pa.

neutral.EN: Hold your ground right there. Do not advance.
neutral.TL: Diyan ka lang. Huwag kang susulong.

neutral.EN: Lower your weapon and step back.
neutral.TL: Ibaba mo ang armas mo at umatras.

neutral.EN: This is your only warning. Back off.
neutral.TL: Ito na ang nag-iisang babala mo. Umatras ka.

warm.EN: Hey, please, don't do this. Step back.
warm.TL: Huy, pakiusap, huwag mong gawin 'to. Umatras ka.

warm.EN: We don't need blood spilled today. Put it down.
warm.TL: Di natin kailangang magpadanak ng dugo ngayon. Ibaba mo 'yan.

warm.EN: Listen to reason, friend. Step away before someone gets hurt.
warm.TL: Makinig ka sa katwiran, kaibigan. Lumayo ka bago may masaktan.

warm.EN: I don't want to hurt you. Please, back off.
warm.TL: Ayaw kitang saktan. Pakiusap, umatras ka.

warm.EN: Don't throw your life away over this. Stand down.
warm.TL: Huwag mong itapon ang buhay mo dahil dito. Ibaba ang armas.

warm.EN: We can still walk away peacefully. Step back.
warm.TL: Maaari pa tayong lumayo nang payapa. Umatras ka.

warm.EN: Take a breath and think about what you're doing. Back up.
warm.TL: Huminga ka muna at isipin ang ginagawa mo. Umatras ka.

warm.EN: I value your life, but I will protect mine. Please stop.
warm.TL: Mahalaga ang buhay mo, pero poprotektahan ko ang akin. Pakiusap tigil.

warm.EN: Don't make me do something we'll both regret. Step back.
warm.TL: Huwag mo akong piliting gumawa ng pagsisisihan natin. Umatras ka.

warm.EN: We're both survivors. Let's keep it that way. Back down.
warm.TL: Pareho tayong nakaligtas. Panatilihin nating ganoon. Huminahon ka.
